user.title: Akuvox SmartPlus Sign-In
user.description: Choose a sign-in method to connect to your Akuvox SmartPlus account:

sms_sign_in_warning.title: SMS Verification
sms_sign_in_warning.description: Warning: Akuvox sessions use rotating credentials. For reliable automatic refresh, use a dedicated family/member account for Home Assistant and do not keep that account active in the SmartPlus app.

sms_sign_in.title: SMS Verification
sms_sign_in.description: Please enter your mobile phone number to receive your verification SMS:

data.subdomain: Manually set the regional API subdomain

app_tokens_sign_in.title: Sign In via App Tokens
app_tokens_sign_in.description: Enter the complete token set captured from SmartPlus. A dedicated family/member account is recommended because Home Assistant and the app cannot safely rotate the same session independently.

data.subdomain: Manually set the regional API subdomain

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Akuvox SmartPlus
reauth_confirm.description: The saved Akuvox session can no longer be refreshed. Enter a newly captured complete token set.

verify_sms_code.title: SMS Code Verification
verify_sms_code.description: Please enter the SMS code you received.

data_description.sms_code: It may take up to 60 seconds to receive the SMS.

init.title: SmartPlus User Tokens & Event Configuration
init.description: Replace the complete token set if Akuvox requires reauthentication. Home Assistant will own and automatically rotate this session.

data.country: The country registered in your Akuvox SmartPlus account
data.override: Use the following SmartPlus account tokens:
data.subdomain: Manually set the regional API subdomain
data.enable_door_events: Poll Akuvox for door-ring and door-open events

error.invalid_auth: Akuvox rejected the supplied token set.
